flashcard_questions.q: Who discovered in 1799 that nitrous oxide reduced pain?
Which Scottish doctor introduced chloroform as an anaesthetic in 1847?
Which year did Queen Victoria use chloroform during the birth of Prince Leopold?
Who calculated accurate chloroform dosages for Queen Victoria's childbirth?
What name is given to the years from 1846 to 1870, when surgical death rates rose?
Which chemical did Joseph Lister use as the first surgical antiseptic in 1865?
Which boy's compound fracture was treated in Lister's first antiseptic operation?
Lister cut the death rate from gangrene in his male surgical ward from 46% to ____.
Which journal published Lister's antiseptic findings in 1867?
What name is given to surgery carried out in a completely germ-free environment?
Who discovered the different human blood groups in 1901?
Which chemical did Richard Lewisohn add to blood in 1915 to stop it clotting?
Which year was the first blood bank set up, for the Battle of Cambrai?
Who pioneered plastic surgery on facial injuries at Sidcup during the First World War?

notes: 15 cards: 7 person to discovery, 4 event to date, 2 term to definition, 1 cloze on Lister's death-rate figure, 1 named patient. Dropped Horace Wells and Morton to avoid three interfering 'early anaesthetic' cards; kept Davy as the named 1799 discovery.
